name: claude-tiktok
description: TikTok-voice spoken summary when Claude Code needs your input.

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.description: Optional. With a key you get a spoken summary of what Claude said; leave it empty and you just get the ding, with no API calls at all. Get one at https://console.anthropic.com and load prepaid credits — Haiku 4.5 costs ~$0.0002 per summary. Billed separately from your Claude Code subscription. $5 buys roughly 25,000 summaries.
